query: I'm evaluating an 80‑year‑old female on invasive mechanical ventilation. In female ICU patients age 75–85 on ventilation, what's the 90th percentile of the 48‑hour composite instability score, and what are hypotension, tachycardia, ICU LOS, and mortality in the top 25%?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) within GROUP (ORDER BY (s.anchor_age - 80)) AS ninety_percentile, COUNT(*) filter (WHERE (s.anchor_age - 80) > 0) AS patients_with_instability_score, SUM(CASE WHEN d.deathtime IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) filter (WHERE (s.anchor_age - 80) > 0) AS patients_with_death, SUM(CASE WHEN i.los > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) filter (WHERE (s.anchor_age - 80) > 0) AS patients_with_long_icu_stay FROM icu_patients s JOIN chartevents c ON s.hadm_id = c.hadm_id JOIN datetimesevents dte ON c.charttime = dte.charttime JOIN icustays i ON s.hadm_id = i.hadm_id WHERE s.gender = 'F' AND s.anchor_age BETWEEN 75 AND 85 AND i.ventilation_mode = 'IMV' AND dte.value = 'Hypotension' AND dte.valueuom = 'mmHg' AND dte.seq_num = 1 AND c.itemid = 42675 AND c.icd_version = '2018' AND dte.charttime BETWEEN (i.intime - interval '48 hours') AND i.intime;
